question: Which religion has the maximum number of followers in Bhutan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddhism**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Buddhism** is the religion with the maximum number of followers in **Bhutan**.
 
• Bhutan is a predominantly Buddhist country, and it is the state religion.
 
• The majority of the Bhutanese population practices Vajrayana Buddhism.
